'''Crote''' was a [[Bimm/Legends|Bimm]] who served as a go-between when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] commissioned a group of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] to track down [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]. Crote was to contact the elusive hunter known as [[Andov Syn|Nariss Siv Loqesh]] and inform him that the Empire required his services. Nariss refused and asked the Bimm to tell the Empire that he had disappeared. Crote did so, resulting in a twenty-five thousand [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] bounty on the hunter.
